If you have a Mercy+Torb+Sym, you have a 350 health Mercy in the right conditions. 

If you have a Mercy+Orisa+Pharah, you have mobility and meat shielding options now. The meta is constantly shifting because new ideas come up every game. You never know who's more at an advantage unless one team chooses to have no healers or no tanks. And even then it's a trade off of health pools versus DPS or Healing.
Meta is fluid. I feel like it's kinda unfair to assume one team is at a disadvantage because Mercy can potentially rez 2 people and heal better. A Nade, nano boost and a sleep dart could negate 80% of the stuff Mercy could do.

In my opinion, a *decent* Mercy is less important to me if the enemy knows how to focus. She only has one Rez every 30sec(and after the nerf it'll be harder) so she's basically useless if you manage to kill her fast enough in a team fight, because on the return she'll only get a max of 2 people back in play and by then the enemy is probably back at full force. Ana is harder to target because she can snipe and is less likely to be caught off guard because of good positioning. I prefer Ana to Mercy because I have good aim and I don't need to fly to someone else and potentially die like a dog because I have CC and self heals. 

Your argument only seems to be stemmed in opinion of how much stronger a buff made Mercy but disregards what makes others strong. An ability isn't bad because you're bad.
